vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm came back with 520 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇯🇵 Japanese. You share no language at all.
🍽️ Ernestine leaves the foraging basket at the door. "The pantry can't take more — sitting with the elders instead."
🛡️ Blanca, Ernestine, Carol and Ezra met them at the door — 4 put down. Blanca, Ernestine, Carol, Ezra are hurt.
🛡️ Blanca, Ezra, Bebhinn and Ursula met them at the door — 4 put down. Blanca, Ezra, Ursula are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Bebhinn just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Carol, Naran, Ursula and Henry met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off. Ursula, Henry are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Bebhinn just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ursula just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ezra, Naran and Ursula met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Ursula is hurt.
🍽️ Yuki leaves the foraging basket at the door. "The pantry can't take more — sitting with the elders instead."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Yuki just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🍽️ Ezra leaves the foraging basket at the door. "The pantry can't take more — sitting with the elders instead."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
★ IDENTIFIED: Elderberry. White flower clusters in spring, dark berries in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Carol taught everyone about Elderberry. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Carol drew Elderberry in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Elderberry — named and noted.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
